Definition: to glow or grow warm; figuratively (usually) to blaze up, of anger, zeal, jealousy
BiblicalUsage: Charah is burning anger, and it kindles in God and in men alike. The Spirit of God came upon Saul and his anger was kindled greatly when he heard the men of Jabesh, and Samuel was grieved when God repented that He had made Saul king. Saul was very wroth when the women sang that David had slain his ten thousands, and the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza when he put his hand to the ark.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe anger in these verses is a fire that reveals what a man loves: Saul's anger flares at a song, Samuel's at a rejected king, God's at a careless hand on holy things. I hold that not all burning is sin, but the burning that guards my own pride always is.
